description:
Holds the order, owner decisions and close-out check for seven items. It is not a batch member and carries no code change.

Delivery mode: serial, one PR per item, one claim at a time. Registered feature delivery mode is not used: three items change the delivery loop itself (pr-arm, heavy-run admission, pr-preflight), one is in another repository, and the policy requires members to be separate top-level sessions.

1. retro-docs-stale-corrections-20261111 (first: other items edit the same AGENTS.md section afterwards)
2. retro-check-failures-name-fix-20261111
3. preflight-runs-docs-inventory-and-project-reference-guards-20261110
4. heavy-run-admission-wait-20261111

Items 2, 3, 4 and 6 are independent of each other; this order only keeps one claim live.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-11 (choice dialog): batch members do not run a local review, re-land the reverted pin with the trunk failure fixed; add `make pr-arm WAIT=<minutes>` and reword AGENTS.md; add opt-in `HEAVY_ADMIT_WAIT` to heavy-run; the remote close-out exception is not live yet, reword only; track the CI failure helper as ci-failure-excerpt-helper-20261111 and do not build it now; delete the /tmp/retro-benchbox scratch at the end.

Rejected in review, with reasons, so they are not rediscovered: a docs/internal index (a copy of the directory listing that drifts); a new doc-path guard (would catch one accepted item); per-target AGENTS.md pointers for tools `make help` lists; the `make review-local` alias; edits to historical review-v2.md sections and ADRs; tests/README.md lock text (it is correct); `PR_OPEN_TITLE` handling (the documented interface is TITLE); a worktree takeover hint (the refusal already prints it).

Guardrails for every member are in each item. Stop conditions for the set: a hold label or unresolved Critical/High review on any PR; an owner-only action; a failed decision gate. On a stop, record the blocker and next action in the affected item's context and continue with items that do not depend on it.
